# Key Findings (auto-generated)

Factual rollup of the current feature dataset. Interpretation lives in the final report.

## Overview
- Posts: 44,288 across 2 platforms (youtube: 38,223, instagram: 6,065).
- Content date range: 2016-04-20 to 2026-09-13.

## Sentiment by platform (English)
- instagram: positive 85.3%, neutral 7.6%, negative 7.1%.
- youtube: positive 62.8%, neutral 21.2%, negative 15.9%.

## Engagement vs sentiment
- Avg engagement percentile by sentiment: negative 0.491, neutral 0.495, positive 0.506 (spread 0.015).
- Relationship is essentially flat (sentiment does not predict engagement).

## Dominant topics (by volume)
- T0: real, cloud, world, engineer - 11,314 posts.
- T11: agent, does, claude, code - 6,258 posts.
- T6: business, help, digitalmarketing, right - 4,388 posts.
- T13: think, better, youtube, idea - 3,642 posts.
- T10: easy, understand, easy understand, simple - 2,186 posts.

## Emerging vs declining topics (recent vs earlier in window)
- Rising: T10: easy, understand, easy understand, simple (+1.99 pts).
- Rising: T11: agent, does, claude, code (+1.96 pts).
- Rising: T8: clear, clearly, clearly clear, explaining clearly (+0.63 pts).
- Declining: T13: think, better, youtube, idea (-1.53 pts).
- Declining: T0: real, cloud, world, engineer (-2.41 pts).

## Top keywords (by volume)
- ChatGPT - 8,517 posts.
- AI Agents - 6,512 posts.
- Automation - 4,634 posts.
- Startup - 4,307 posts.
- SEO - 3,483 posts.

## Models
- Production sentiment model: vader (deploy-domain macro-F1 0.6493).
- Topic model: NMF, k=15, UMass coherence -0.7551 (more coherent than LDA).
